strings.zh: 厉害！以这个劲头{NEWLINE}可以试着到各地去转转。{SCROLL}既然有冲浪技能,{NEWLINE}那么去愤怒湖看看{CLEAR}怎么样呢！

If anything, I{CLEAR}should be the one challenging you.{SCROLL}Of course, I’m no match for you.{NEWLINE}I’d love to just hand you the{CLEAR}Mineral Badge, but I’m afraid that{CLEAR}wouldn’t really follow the rules.{SCROLL}So please face me in a{NEWLINE}battle with restrictions.
